fields.statement: rhiza search finds model nodes by the text of their handles and fields

fields.acceptance: A search.txtar records three nodes and gets them in the expected ranked order; --kind narrows; --limit 1 gives a next_cursor whose page holds the rest; a bad cursor exits 2; a retired node is not found; a node updated in an unlanded change set is found by its new text only under --view what-if:<cs>; search --json and api call search print the same bytes; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated; the index bumps its schema version and rebuilds
fields.statement: rhiza search <text> lists live nodes whose handle or field text matches, ranked, with handle, ID, kind, path, matched field and a snippet, narrowed by --kind, read in any view, and paged with --limit and a cursor

fields.acceptance: A model app unit test on a fake runner types / and text and sees only the search op's hits, and esc restores the tree; rex-install.txtar shows no key moved
fields.statement: In the model app, / opens a filter that shows the nodes rhiza search finds for the typed text, and esc clears it
